ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Where Execution
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may enumerate browser bookmarks to learn more about compromised hosts.
Browser bookmarks may reveal personal information about users (ex: banking sites, interests, social media, etc.) as well as details about
internal network resources such as servers, tools/dashboards, or other related infrastructure.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\where\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "where\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*places\\\.sqlite.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cookies\\\.sqlite.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*formhistory\\\.sqlite.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*logins\\\.json.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*key4\\\.db.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*key3\\\.db.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*sessionstore\\\.jsonlz4.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*History.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Bookmarks.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Cookies.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Login\\ Data.*")))
